hooks.command: git add -A; if git diff --cached --quiet; then exit 0; fi; if ! git commit -q -m "Auto-save $(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"; then jq -n '{systemMessage: "⚠️ Auto-save: git commit FAILED — this change was NOT saved. Check git status."}'; exit 0; fi; if ERR=$(git push origin main 2>&1 >/dev/null); then exit 0; else jq -n --arg e "$ERR" '{systemMessage: ("⚠️ Auto-save: committed locally but the PUSH TO GITHUB FAILED, so this change exists only on this VM. git push error: " + $e)}'; exit 0; fi
